# ScheduledClicker

Latest stable version: **v1.2.0**, released 2026-10-15. Free MIT-licensed local desktop tool for Windows 11 and macOS 13+. Simple mode schedules one single/double click; loop mode repeats configured prompt input and send clicks within a round limit or deadline. Five interface languages and system-selected light/dark appearance with manual switching.

Official release downloads do not require GitHub sign-in. The loop overwrites the clipboard and performs real input; cancellation cannot undo past actions. Keep the computer awake/unlocked and target fixed. It does not detect AI completion, quota availability or delivery, and does not bypass limits.

Updated 2026-10-15. Supplemental summary; not a guarantee of indexing, ranking or AI citation.

## Timing and prompts

Use one prompt every round or a sequence. A sequence can stop at its end or repeat its last entry. The first execution uses a future local time; each interval starts after the previous round completes. Maximum rounds or a deadline is required; when both are enabled, the first reached stops. Trial performs real input and a send click. Pause/resume applies only between rounds, while the deadline remains active. Pausing during a round stops it. Cancel/F8/close stops remaining steps, never undoing completed paste or clicks.

Capture input and Send in the same visible window. Keep the intended app, chat and layout unchanged. Window checks cannot identify a changed conversation or prove delivery. On macOS, a separate activation stage waits before the input click; target identity is obtained with system-wide Accessibility hit-testing and retained for validation. Only regular accessible app windows are supported. Mac numeric duration/action-delay/round fields support wheel and trackpad adjustment.

## Languages and appearance

Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and German. All Chinese system locales use Traditional Chinese; Japanese/Korean/German use their language; other locales use English. Both modes allow manual switching. Only the untouched initial prompt follows the selected language (繼續 / Continue / 続けて / 계속 / Weiter); edited prompts and active plan text are preserved. Startup follows the system app appearance, and the sun/moon action overrides it for the current session. Restart reads the system choices again.

## Data, permissions and compatibility

No ads, accounts, telemetry, application network access or third-party packages. ScheduledClicker does not persist prompts or schedules after exit. The loop clipboard overwrite is not restored; text can remain in clipboard history or the target app. Simple mode does not use the clipboard. Mac Copy diagnostics includes build/OS, app identity and execution stages, not prompt text or window titles; clicking it replaces the clipboard.

Windows: portable WinForms EXE for Windows 11, unsigned, no installer; higher-integrity administrator apps can reject input. macOS: universal AppKit/Quartz app for macOS 13+ (arm64 and x86_64), user-granted Accessibility permission, ad-hoc signed and not Developer ID signed or notarized. EXE files do not run natively on Mac. Checksums verify file integrity, not trusted authorship.

## Verification scope and history

The owner accepted Mac build12004 normal functionality and Windows prompt-language/custom-text/loop checks, then authorized v1.2.0 publication. CI checks builds, scheduling, capture/focus policies, localization, UI and packaging. Individual desktop failure scenarios and every third-party app/display combination are not guaranteed. Exact build evidence and hashes are in VERIFICATION.md. Older v1.1.2 supports only one-shot clicking; v1.2.0 replaces prior loop preview downloads.

Independent project; not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI. No AI completion, reset recognition or usage-limit bypass.
